recipe.visualDefinition: A soft-focus, warm-toned portrait of a woman with long dark hair, captured in a hazy, golden-hour interior. The subject is centered, wearing a dark V-neck garment, with a strong yellow-gold backlight creating a halo effect on the left side of the frame. A blurred floral arrangement sits in the background to the right, contributing to a domestic, intimate atmosphere.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast relationship between the dark silhouette of the clothing and the bright, blown-out golden background.
Soft, diffused skin tones blending into the warm ambient light.
Textural contrast between the smooth facial features and the grainy, analog film quality of the overall image.
coreInvariants: Golden-yellow backlighting on the left side.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centrally positioned, occupying the middle two-thirds of the frame from the chest up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright yellow light source on the left act as primary anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright light on the left, moves across the subject's face, and settles on the dark mass of the clothing at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space on the left filled with light flare; busy but blurred negative space on the right with floral elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Golden yellow and amber (background and highlights).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (clothing and hair shadows).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted pink and peach (skin tones and floral highlights).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellows; low value in the foreground subject; overall low contrast in mid-tones due to haze.

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over the brightest area of the background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with weight and color variation to distinguish hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Thin black outlines on primary text to ensure legibility against bright backgrounds.

preserve: Muted pink and brown color scheme

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 1970s aesthetic and clean stroke weight.
Captures the period-accurate geometric feel with wide tracking.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus 1970s film portrait of a woman with long dark hair, centered, wearing a dark V-neck. The scene is an interior with heavy golden-hour backlighting from the left, creating a hazy glow. A blurred bouquet of flowers is in the background on the right. Use a warm, grainy, analog film aesthetic.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of left-aligned uppercase text in the top-left corner. The top line should be a medium-weight geometric sans-serif in muted pink with a thin black outline. The second line should be a bold geometric sans-serif in deep ochre.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting warm and hazy?
Is the text left-aligned in the top-left corner?
Does the image have visible film grain?
Is the subject centered and in soft focus?

adjustableVariables: Blurriness of the background floral elements
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the backlight doesn't obscure the subject's facial features entirely.
Check that the pink text outline is thin enough to be subtle.
Verify the grain is uniform and not digital noise.
Confirm the color palette remains strictly in the warm/amber spectrum.
recipe.reuseFormula: Soft-focus portrait + Golden-hour backlight + Geometric Sans-Serif Typography (Top-Left) + Analog Film Grain = 1970s Folk Aesthetic.
